title: Multiple inline XML BLOB items share a buffer that is resized before consumption
description:
Pending inline XML BLOB items share parser scratch memory resized before vector consumption; upstream multi-item vectors can cause stale pointers or reads beyond resized storage. Next: stable per-item ownership and cleanup; moving/shrinking allocation regressions. Confirmed by current source contracts; no fix or runtime retest claimed.
